input.headline: João Pedro sits out as Gabriel's 17 points top a low-scoring Gameweek 8

cards.text: Haaland's goal kept captains ticking over, but the most vice-captained player, João Pedro, never got off the bench.

cards.title: Popular picks that let owners down
cards.text: Four of the most-owned players in the game delivered almost nothing, which goes a long way to explaining the lowest average of the season so far.

cards.title: Arsenal's defenders steal the show
cards.text: Both scored in the 2-0 win over Everton. Gabriel's 17 points made him the gameweek's top scorer and is his best score this season.

cards.title: Bournemouth run riot
cards.text: Hill (11 points), Truffert (10 points), Rayan (10 points) and Tavernier (10 points) all hauled, and only Tavernier was widely owned.
The Tavernier bandwagon paid off with a goal, while the sellers of Saka and B.Fernandes lost nothing.
